notablePrerequisites: There are at least X creature cards in all graveyards.
description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Drakestown Forgotten.
When Drakestown Forgotten dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
